nodes.summary: Parse the report name, options, and the single log path.
nodes.instructions: Take the report name first, then parse options with a local flag.FlagSet using flag.ContinueOnError, then require exactly one log path. Because flag stops at the first positional argument, parse options after the report name. Unknown reports and options are passed to cli-usage.
nodes.name: Parse the report name, options, and the single log path.

nodes.summary: Reject usage errors with exit code 2.
provides: usage-error path with exit 2 and empty stdout
nodes.instructions: An unknown report, unknown option, missing option value, repeated option, or missing or extra log path exits 2 with nothing on stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr. An unrecognized -h or --help is an unknown option.
nodes.name: Reject usage errors with exit code 2.

nodes.summary: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.
nodes.instructions: Write the header row first, comma-separated, with \n line endings. A zero-match report writes its header and, where it has one, a zero TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.

nodes.summary: Format summed cost with four decimal places.
nodes.instructions: Write the summed cost_usd with %.4f. A zero total renders 0.0000.
nodes.name: Format summed cost with four decimal places.

nodes.summary: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.
nodes.instructions: Compute t = (ms + 3000) / 6000 in integer division and render it as t/10, a period, and t%10. 95000 ms renders 1.6. Zero renders 0.0.
nodes.name: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.

nodes.summary: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.
provides: logfile line reader for a file path
nodes.instructions: Read the file as UTF-8, one line at a time. Blank lines are ignored and are not counted as skipped. Pass each non-blank line on as raw bytes for parsing.
nodes.name: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.

nodes.summary: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.
nodes.instructions: When the log file cannot be opened or read, exit 1 with nothing on stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr.
nodes.name: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.

nodes.summary: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.
nodes.instructions: Accept --since and --until only as real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD. Any other value is a usage error with exit 2, including an invalid date that appears after the log path.
nodes.name: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.

nodes.summary: Parse records and skip non-object, incomplete, and duplicate lines.
provides: record parser with whole-file skipped count
nodes.instructions: Parse each line as a JSON object. Skip a line that is not an object, lacks a non-empty execution_id, started_at, status, job.command_name, or job.target, or repeats the execution_id of an earlier kept record. Keep the first occurrence. Write one stderr warning per skipped line naming its line number, and never write to stdout. Skipping never changes the exit code. Expose the total skipped count over the whole file.
nodes.name: Parse records and skip non-object, incomplete, and duplicate lines.

nodes.summary: Attribute each record to its executed or requested model.
nodes.instructions: A record's model is result.stats.model when it is present and non-empty, otherwise job.model.
nodes.name: Attribute each record to its executed or requested model.

nodes.summary: Treat absent or null numeric stats as zero.
provides: and elapsed accessors defaulting to zero
nodes.instructions: A missing or null input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, or elapsed_ms counts as zero. A record with no result.stats object is still a record.
nodes.name: Treat absent or null numeric stats as zero.

nodes.summary: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.
nodes.instructions: A record is failed when status is any value other than succeeded. Expose its started_at, target, command, model, returncode (nullable), and timed_out for the failures report.
nodes.name: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.

nodes.summary: Filter records by an inclusive start-date range.
nodes.instructions: Keep records whose start date (the first 10 characters of started_at) is on or after --since and on or before --until when given. A range that matches nothing yields zero matching records and exit 0.
nodes.name: Filter records by an inclusive start-date range.

nodes.summary: Filter records by Target name.
nodes.instructions: Keep only records whose job.target equals the --target value exactly. Expose the filter as a predicate that every report applies.
nodes.name: Filter records by Target name.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-start-date report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per start date ascending. tokens is input plus cached plus output. Follow with a TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the per-start-date report.

nodes.summary: Produce the failed-record report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per failed record ordered by started_at then execution_id. returncode is empty when null or absent, and timed_out is true or false. This report has no TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the failed-record report.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-Target report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per Target ordered ascending by byte value, with cost and minutes columns, followed by a TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the per-Target report.

nodes.summary: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.
nodes.instructions: The skipped count is computed over the whole log and ignores --target, --since, and --until. Test it by running the same log with and without filters.
nodes.name: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-provider and per-model report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per provider and model pair ordered by provider then model ascending. The TOTAL row leaves the provider and model cells empty.
nodes.name: Produce the per-provider and per-model report.

nodes.summary: Produce the one-row summary report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row with the header records,skipped,succeeded,failed,first,last,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes. first and last are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when no record matches.
nodes.name: Produce the one-row summary report.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-command report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per command ordered by calls descending, then command ascending by byte value, followed by a TOTAL row over all filtered records.
nodes.name: Produce the per-command report.

nodes.summary: Provide the ddkstat entry point and the Run dispatcher.
nodes.instructions: Add cmd/ddkstat/main.go, which calls internal/cli Run with os.Args[1:] and exits with its returned code. Only main calls os.Exit. The application root must build with go build ./cmd/ddkstat.
nodes.name: Provide the ddkstat entry point and the Run dispatcher.

nodes.summary: Parse the report name, options, and the single log path.
nodes.instructions: Take the report name first, then parse options with a local flag.FlagSet using flag.ContinueOnError, then require exactly one log path. Because flag stops at the first positional argument, parse options after the report name. Unknown reports and options are passed to cli-usage.
nodes.name: Parse the report name, options, and the single log path.

nodes.summary: Reject usage errors with exit code 2.
provides: usage-error path with exit 2 and empty stdout
nodes.instructions: An unknown report, unknown option, missing option value, repeated option, or missing or extra log path exits 2 with nothing on stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr. An unrecognized -h or --help is an unknown option.
nodes.name: Reject usage errors with exit code 2.

nodes.summary: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.
nodes.instructions: Write the header row first, comma-separated, with \n line endings. A zero-match report writes its header and, where it has one, a zero TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.

nodes.summary: Format summed cost with four decimal places.
nodes.instructions: Write the summed cost_usd with %.4f. A zero total renders 0.0000.
nodes.name: Format summed cost with four decimal places.

nodes.summary: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.
nodes.instructions: Compute t = (ms + 3000) / 6000 in integer division and render it as t/10, a period, and t%10. 95000 ms renders 1.6. Zero renders 0.0.
nodes.name: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.

nodes.summary: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.
provides: logfile line reader for a file path
nodes.instructions: Read the file as UTF-8, one line at a time. Blank lines are ignored and are not counted as skipped. Pass each non-blank line on as raw bytes for parsing.
nodes.name: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.

nodes.summary: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.
nodes.instructions: When the log file cannot be opened or read, exit 1 with nothing on stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr.
nodes.name: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.

nodes.summary: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.
nodes.instructions: Accept --since and --until only as real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD. Any other value is a usage error with exit 2, including an invalid date that appears after the log path.
nodes.name: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.

nodes.summary: Parse records and skip non-object, incomplete, and duplicate lines.
provides: record parser with whole-file skipped count
nodes.instructions: Parse each line as a JSON object. Skip a line that is not an object, lacks a non-empty execution_id, started_at, status, job.command_name, or job.target, or repeats the execution_id of an earlier kept record. Keep the first occurrence. Write one stderr warning per skipped line naming its line number, and never write to stdout. Skipping never changes the exit code. Expose the total skipped count over the whole file.
nodes.name: Parse records and skip non-object, incomplete, and duplicate lines.

nodes.summary: Attribute each record to its executed or requested model.
nodes.instructions: A record's model is result.stats.model when it is present and non-empty, otherwise job.model.
nodes.name: Attribute each record to its executed or requested model.

nodes.summary: Treat absent or null numeric stats as zero.
provides: and elapsed accessors defaulting to zero
nodes.instructions: A missing or null input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, or elapsed_ms counts as zero. A record with no result.stats object is still a record.
nodes.name: Treat absent or null numeric stats as zero.

nodes.summary: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.
nodes.instructions: A record is failed when status is any value other than succeeded. Expose its started_at, target, command, model, returncode (nullable), and timed_out for the failures report.
nodes.name: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.

nodes.summary: Filter records by an inclusive start-date range.
nodes.instructions: Keep records whose start date (the first 10 characters of started_at) is on or after --since and on or before --until when given. A range that matches nothing yields zero matching records and exit 0.
nodes.name: Filter records by an inclusive start-date range.

nodes.summary: Filter records by Target name.
nodes.instructions: Keep only records whose job.target equals the --target value exactly. Expose the filter as a predicate that every report applies.
nodes.name: Filter records by Target name.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-start-date report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per start date ascending. tokens is input plus cached plus output. Follow with a TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the per-start-date report.

nodes.summary: Produce the failed-record report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per failed record ordered by started_at then execution_id. returncode is empty when null or absent, and timed_out is true or false. This report has no TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the failed-record report.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-Target report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per Target ordered ascending by byte value, with cost and minutes columns, followed by a TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the per-Target report.

nodes.summary: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.
nodes.instructions: The skipped count is computed over the whole log and ignores --target, --since, and --until. Test it by running the same log with and without filters.
nodes.name: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-provider and per-model report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per provider and model pair ordered by provider then model ascending. The TOTAL row leaves the provider and model cells empty.
nodes.name: Produce the per-provider and per-model report.

nodes.summary: Produce the one-row summary report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row with the header records,skipped,succeeded,failed,first,last,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes. first and last are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when no record matches.
nodes.name: Produce the one-row summary report.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-command report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per command ordered by calls descending, then command ascending by byte value, followed by a TOTAL row over all filtered records.
nodes.name: Produce the per-command report.

nodes.summary: Provide the ddkstat entry point and the Run dispatcher.
nodes.instructions: Add cmd/ddkstat/main.go, which calls internal/cli Run with os.Args[1:] and exits with its returned code. Only main calls os.Exit. The application root must build with go build ./cmd/ddkstat.
nodes.name: Provide the ddkstat entry point and the Run dispatcher.

nodes.summary: Parse the report name, options, and the single log path.
nodes.instructions: Take the report name first, then parse options with a local flag.FlagSet using flag.ContinueOnError, then require exactly one log path. Because flag stops at the first positional argument, parse options after the report name. Unknown reports and options are passed to cli-usage.
nodes.name: Parse the report name, options, and the single log path.

nodes.summary: Reject usage errors with exit code 2.
provides: usage-error path with exit 2 and empty stdout
nodes.instructions: An unknown report, unknown option, missing option value, repeated option, or missing or extra log path exits 2 with nothing on stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr. An unrecognized -h or --help is an unknown option.
nodes.name: Reject usage errors with exit code 2.

nodes.summary: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.
nodes.instructions: Write the header row first, comma-separated, with \n line endings. A zero-match report writes its header and, where it has one, a zero TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.

nodes.summary: Format summed cost with four decimal places.
nodes.instructions: Write the summed cost_usd with %.4f. A zero total renders 0.0000.
nodes.name: Format summed cost with four decimal places.

nodes.summary: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.
nodes.instructions: Compute t = (ms + 3000) / 6000 in integer division and render it as t/10, a period, and t%10. 95000 ms renders 1.6. Zero renders 0.0.
nodes.name: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.

nodes.summary: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.
provides: logfile line reader for a file path
nodes.instructions: Read the file as UTF-8, one line at a time. Blank lines are ignored and are not counted as skipped. Pass each non-blank line on as raw bytes for parsing.
nodes.name: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.

nodes.summary: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.
nodes.instructions: When the log file cannot be opened or read, exit 1 with nothing on stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr.
nodes.name: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.

nodes.summary: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.
nodes.instructions: Accept --since and --until only as real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD. Any other value is a usage error with exit 2, including an invalid date that appears after the log path.
nodes.name: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.

nodes.summary: Parse records and skip non-object, incomplete, and duplicate lines.
provides: record parser with whole-file skipped count
nodes.instructions: Parse each line as a JSON object. Skip a line that is not an object, lacks a non-empty execution_id, started_at, status, job.command_name, or job.target, or repeats the execution_id of an earlier kept record. Keep the first occurrence. Write one stderr warning per skipped line naming its line number, and never write to stdout. Skipping never changes the exit code. Expose the total skipped count over the whole file.
nodes.name: Parse records and skip non-object, incomplete, and duplicate lines.

nodes.summary: Attribute each record to its executed or requested model.
nodes.instructions: A record's model is result.stats.model when it is present and non-empty, otherwise job.model.
nodes.name: Attribute each record to its executed or requested model.

nodes.summary: Treat absent or null numeric stats as zero.
provides: and elapsed accessors defaulting to zero
nodes.instructions: A missing or null input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, or elapsed_ms counts as zero. A record with no result.stats object is still a record.
nodes.name: Treat absent or null numeric stats as zero.

nodes.summary: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.
nodes.instructions: A record is failed when status is any value other than succeeded. Expose its started_at, target, command, model, returncode (nullable), and timed_out for the failures report.
nodes.name: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.

nodes.summary: Filter records by an inclusive start-date range.
nodes.instructions: Keep records whose start date (the first 10 characters of started_at) is on or after --since and on or before --until when given. A range that matches nothing yields zero matching records and exit 0.
nodes.name: Filter records by an inclusive start-date range.

nodes.summary: Filter records by Target name.
nodes.instructions: Keep only records whose job.target equals the --target value exactly. Expose the filter as a predicate that every report applies.
nodes.name: Filter records by Target name.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-start-date report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per start date ascending. tokens is input plus cached plus output. Follow with a TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the per-start-date report.

nodes.summary: Produce the failed-record report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per failed record ordered by started_at then execution_id. returncode is empty when null or absent, and timed_out is true or false. This report has no TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the failed-record report.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-Target report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per Target ordered ascending by byte value, with cost and minutes columns, followed by a TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the per-Target report.

nodes.summary: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.
nodes.instructions: The skipped count is computed over the whole log and ignores --target, --since, and --until. Test it by running the same log with and without filters.
nodes.name: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-provider and per-model report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per provider and model pair ordered by provider then model ascending. The TOTAL row leaves the provider and model cells empty.
nodes.name: Produce the per-provider and per-model report.

nodes.summary: Produce the one-row summary report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row with the header records,skipped,succeeded,failed,first,last,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes. first and last are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when no record matches.
nodes.name: Produce the one-row summary report.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-command report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per command ordered by calls descending, then command ascending by byte value, followed by a TOTAL row over all filtered records.
nodes.name: Produce the per-command report.

nodes.name: Reject usage errors with exit code 2.

nodes.summary: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.

nodes.name: Write CSV with a header, LF line endings, and TOTAL rows.

nodes.summary: Format summed cost with four decimal places.
nodes.instructions: Write the summed cost_usd with %.4f. A zero total renders 0.0000.
nodes.name: Format summed cost with four decimal places.

nodes.summary: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.
nodes.instructions: Compute t = (ms + 3000) / 6000 in integer division and render it as t/10, a period, and t%10. 95000 ms renders 1.6. Zero renders 0.0.
nodes.name: Format minutes in tenths of a minute.

nodes.summary: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.
provides: logfile line reader for a file path
nodes.instructions: Read the file as UTF-8, one line at a time. Blank lines are ignored and are not counted as skipped. Pass each non-blank line on as raw bytes for parsing.
nodes.name: Read JSON Lines log records from a file path.

nodes.summary: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.
nodes.instructions: When the log file cannot be opened or read, exit 1 with nothing on stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr.
nodes.name: Report operational log read failures with exit code 1.

nodes.summary: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.
nodes.instructions: Accept --since and --until only as real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD. Any other value is a usage error with exit 2, including an invalid date that appears after the log path.
nodes.name: Validate date option values as real calendar dates.

nodes.summary: Parse records and skip non-object, incomplete, and duplicate lines.
provides: record parser with whole-file skipped count
nodes.instructions: Parse each line as a JSON object. Skip a line that is not an object, lacks a non-empty execution_id, started_at, status, job.command_name, or job.target, or repeats the execution_id of an earlier kept record. Keep the first occurrence. Write one stderr warning per skipped line naming its line number, and never write to stdout. Skipping never changes the exit code. nodes.summary: Treat absent or null numeric stats as zero.
provides: and elapsed accessors defaulting to zero

nodes.summary: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.

nodes.name: Classify a record as failed when its status is not succeeded.

nodes.summary: Filter records by Target name.
nodes.instructions: Keep only records whose job.target equals the --target value exactly. Expose the filter as a predicate that every report applies.
nodes.name: Filter records by Target name.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-start-date report.

nodes.summary: Produce the failed-record report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per failed record ordered by started_at then execution_id. returncode is empty when null or absent, and timed_out is true or false. This report has no TOTAL row.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-Target report.
nodes.instructions: Write one row per Target ordered ascending by byte value, with cost and minutes columns, followed by a TOTAL row.
nodes.name: Produce the per-Target report.

nodes.summary: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.

nodes.name: Count skipped lines over the whole file regardless of filters.

nodes.name: Produce the per-provider and per-model report.

nodes.summary: Produce the one-row summary report.

nodes.summary: Produce the per-command report.
